import numpy as np

def softmax(Z):
    Z = np.asarray(Z, dtype=np.float64)
    single = Z.ndim == 1
    if single:
        Z = Z.reshape(1, -1)
    Z = np.where(np.isnan(Z), -np.inf, Z)
    n_classes = Z.shape[1]
    P = np.empty_like(Z, dtype=np.float64)
    row_max = np.max(Z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    finite = np.isfinite(row_max).ravel()
    if np.any(finite):
        Zf = Z[finite]
        m = row_max[finite]
        e = np.exp(Zf - m)
        P[finite] = e / np.sum(e, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    pos_inf = np.isposinf(row_max).ravel()
    if np.any(pos_inf):
        mask = np.isposinf(Z[pos_inf])
        counts = np.sum(mask, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        P[pos_inf] = mask / counts
    neg_inf = np.isneginf(row_max).ravel()
    if np.any(neg_inf):
        P[neg_inf] = 1.0 / n_classes
    if single:
        return P[0]
    return P

def cross_entropy(Z, y):
    Z = np.asarray(Z, dtype=np.float64)
    if Z.ndim == 1:
        Z = Z.reshape(1, -1)
    Z = np.where(np.isnan(Z), -np.inf, Z)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1)
    n_samples, n_classes = Z.shape
    if n_samples == 0:
        return 0.0
    if y.size == 1 and n_samples != 1:
        y = np.full(n_samples, y.item(), dtype=np.int64)
    elif y.size != n_samples:
        y = np.broadcast_to(y, (n_samples,)).astype(np.int64, copy=False)
    true_logits = Z[np.arange(n_samples), y]
    losses = np.empty(n_samples, dtype=np.float64)
    row_max = np.max(Z, axis=1)
    finite = np.isfinite(row_max)
    if np.any(finite):
        Zf = Z[finite]
        m = row_max[finite][:, None]
        e = np.exp(Zf - m)
        log_sum = np.log(np.sum(e, axis=1))
        true_shifted = true_logits[finite] - m[:, 0]
        losses[finite] = log_sum - true_shifted
    pos_inf = np.isposinf(row_max)
    if np.any(pos_inf):
        mask = np.isposinf(Z[pos_inf])
        counts = np.sum(mask, axis=1)
        true_pos = np.isposinf(true_logits[pos_inf])
        losses[pos_inf] = np.where(true_pos, np.log(counts), np.inf)
    neg_inf = np.isneginf(row_max)
    if np.any(neg_inf):
        losses[neg_inf] = np.log(n_classes)
    return float(np.mean(losses))

import numpy as np

def cross_entropy(Z, y):
    Z = np.asarray(Z, dtype=np.float64)
    if Z.ndim == 1:
        Z = Z.reshape(1, -1)
    Z = np.where(np.isnan(Z), -np.inf, Z)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1)
    n_samples, n_classes = Z.shape
    if n_samples == 0 or n_classes == 0:
        return 0.0
    if y.size == 1 and n_samples != 1:
        y = np.full(n_samples, y.item(), dtype=np.int64)
    elif y.size != n_samples:
        y = np.broadcast_to(y, (n_samples,)).astype(np.int64, copy=False)
    true_logits = Z[np.arange(n_samples), y]
    losses = np.empty(n_samples, dtype=np.float64)
    row_max = np.max(Z, axis=1)
    finite = np.isfinite(row_max)
    if np.any(finite):
        Zf = Z[finite]
        m = row_max[finite][:, None]
        with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            e = np.exp(Zf - m)
            log_sum = np.log(np.sum(e, axis=1))
            true_shifted = true_logits[finite] - m[:, 0]
            losses[finite] = log_sum - true_shifted
    pos_inf = np.isposinf(row_max)
    if np.any(pos_inf):
        mask = np.isposinf(Z[pos_inf])
        counts = np.sum(mask, axis=1)
        true_pos = np.isposinf(true_logits[pos_inf])
        losses[pos_inf] = np.where(true_pos, np.log(counts), np.inf)
    neg_inf = np.isneginf(row_max)
    if np.any(neg_inf):
        losses[neg_inf] = np.log(n_classes)
    return float(np.mean(losses))

def softmax(Z):
    Z = np.asarray(Z, dtype=np.float64)
    single = Z.ndim == 1
    if single:
        Z = Z.reshape(1, -1)
    Z = np.where(np.isnan(Z), -np.inf, Z)
    n_classes = Z.shape[1]
    if n_classes == 0:

    row_max = np.max(Z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    finite = np.isfinite(row_max).ravel()
    if np.any(finite):
        Zf = Z[finite]
        m = row_max[finite]
        with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            e = np.exp(Zf - m)
            P[finite] = e / np.sum(e, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    pos_inf = np.isposinf(row_max).ravel()
    if np.any(pos_inf):
        mask = np.isposinf(Z[pos_inf])
        counts = np.sum(mask, axis=1, keepdims=True)
        P[pos_inf] = mask / counts
    neg_inf = np.isneginf(row_max).ravel()
    if np.any(neg_inf):
        P[neg_inf] = 1.0 / n_classes
    if single:
        return P[0]
    return P

    Z = np.asarray(Z, dtype=np.float64)
    if Z.ndim == 1:
        Z = Z.reshape(1, -1)
    Z = np.where(np.isnan(Z), -np.inf, Z)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1)
    n_samples, n_classes = Z.shape
    if n_samples == 0 or n_classes == 0:
        return 0.0
    if y.size == 1 and n_samples != 1:
        y = np.full(n_samples, y.item(), dtype=np.int64)
    elif y.size != n_samples:
        y = np.broadcast_to(y, (n_samples,)).astype(np.int64, copy=False)
    true_logits = Z[np.arange(n_samples), y]
    losses = np.empty(n_samples, dtype=np.float64)
    row_max = np.max(Z, axis=1)
    finite = np.isfinite(row_max)
    if np.any(finite):

        with np.errstate(over='ignore', under='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
            e = np.exp(Zf - m)
            log_sum = np.log(np.sum(e, axis=1))
            true_shifted = true_logits[finite] - m[:, 0]
            losses[finite] = log_sum - true_shifted

    neg_inf = np.isneginf(row_max)
